# Super Guarantee Rate 2025-26: Current Rate, Due Dates and What Changes Next
The super guarantee rate for 2025-26 is 12% of ordinary time earnings, up from 11.5% in 2024-25.

## What is the super guarantee rate for 2025-26?
The SG rate for the financial year starting 1 July 2025 is **12%** of each eligible employee's ordinary time earnings (OTE).

The 12% rate applies to all salary and wages paid on or after 1 July 2025, even if some of the pay period falls before that date.

## Super guarantee rate history
| Financial year | SG rate |
|-|-|
| **2025-26** | **12.0%** |

## Common _questions_
The superannuation guarantee rate for the 2025-26 financial year is 12% of ordinary time earnings.

The super guarantee rate increased from 11.5% to 12% on 1 July 2025.

results.description:
# Super guarantee rates: a history
## Super guarantee explained
Today, the super guarantee is **12%**—the result of a long, gradual increase designed to help Australians build more adequate retirement savings.

## How the super guarantee has evolved
|  |  |  |  |
|-|-|-|-|
| 1 July 2024 – 30 June 2025 | 11.5% | Albanese (Labor) | Nearing 12%, higher contributions hope to improve outcomes, especially for younger workers and lower-income earners. |
| 1 July 2025 – 30 June 2026 and onwards | 12% | Albanese (Labor) | Reaches target rate. Stronger baseline contributions are hoped to help improve retirement outcomes more broadly. |
